info.title: Wolfari Places and Selected Locations
info.description: Lưu một kết quả tìm kiếm: POST /api/v1/trips/{trip_id}/selected-locations với `selection_token` (xem plan-items.openapi.json).

get.description: Authenticated trip reader only. Explicit submit; no autocomplete. Wolfari POI catalogue first: the active snapshot holds the curated golden list plus (POI-OVERTURE) nationwide Overture Places. With q, the search looks within 50 km of latitude/longitude first and widens nationwide when that yields fewer than 3 good matches; golden POIs always rank first on an exact or contained name. Without q, points within radius_m. With bbox (map exploration), up to limit points in the frame by tier then confidence; radius_m and q are ignored, Geoapify is never called and coordinate pile-ups (≥ 20 POIs on one exact coordinate) are hidden. Geoapify is consulted only when the catalogue falls short (fewer than 3 good matches, none nearby, or geocode=true) and its results are appended without duplicates. Without category only tourism is searched (unchanged default until the web ships the 4-group UI; then tourism, restaurant, cafe and accommodation).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Search group. Omitted: tourism (for now; later tourism + restaurant + cafe + accommodation). all: every group. Earlier values keep their meaning.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Map frame minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat (WGS84). At most 2 degrees per side, else 400 BBOX_TOO_LARGE; malformed: 400 INVALID_BBOX.

200.description: Normalized search results; empty and provider failure are explicit meta states.

400.description: VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_BBOX or BBOX_TOO_LARGE. Authentication, authorization, conflict and availability use the other codes. No upstream secrets.

401.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, state/version conflict or unavailable service. No upstream secrets.

403.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, state/version conflict or unavailable service. No upstream secrets.

404.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, state/version conflict or unavailable service. No upstream secrets.

409.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, state/version conflict or unavailable service. No upstream secrets.

503.description: Validation, authentication, authorization, state/version conflict or unavailable service. No upstream secrets.

selection_token.description: Signed token from a search result of provider GEOAPIFY or WOLFARI. Saving the same provider place twice returns the existing location without a new plan_version.

attribution.description: Always present: OpenStreetMap (WOLFARI) or Geoapify + OpenStreetMap.

provider.description: Result source. WOLFARI: id is the curated wolfari_key.

category.description: Wolfari taxonomy code (MAP-POI section 8); empty for Geoapify.

category_label.description: Vietnamese label of category; empty for Geoapify.

tier.description: 1-3 curated golden list; 9 bulk (Overture) or external (Geoapify).

coord_verified.description: Coordinates were checked by a human reviewer.

typical_duration_min.description: Suggested visit duration; omitted when unknown.

activity_type.description: Suggested Plan activity type (SIGHTSEEING, BEACH, ...); may be empty. Clients show unknown values as "Khác".

source_dataset.description: Dataset the place comes from (POI-OVERTURE). Optional for older servers.

category_group.description: Public search group of category; null when unknown.

province_code.description: Province code of the 34 units in force since 2025-07-01; null for Geoapify.

province_name.description: Vietnamese province name, e.g. "Đà Nẵng"; null when unknown.

confidence.description: Overture confidence; null for golden and Geoapify.

data_release.description: Data release of the record, e.g. Overture 2026-10-21.0; null otherwise.

fetched_at.description: When the record was fetched from its provider.

provider.description: Sources that contributed data; GEOAPIFY also when nothing was found.

snapshot_id.description: Active POI snapshot version answering the search.

data_release.description: Overture release of the active snapshot; null for golden-only.

bbox_truncated.description: bbox search: more points in the frame than limit.
